articles.summary: Skyways launches Skyreach, its latest long-range autonomous VTOL cargo aircraft, with flights for defense and commercial customers beginning in December 2026.
articles.title: Skyways Launches Skyreach: Begins Customer Flights with its New Long-Range, High-Payload Autonomous Cargo Platform Built to Scale

articles.summary: Skyways receives FAA authorization for long-range BVLOS operations over the high seas, clearing the way for a planned mission with Shell in the Gulf of America.
articles.title: Skyways and Shell Receive First of its Kind FAA Authorization for Long-Range BVLOS Operations Over the High Seas
